title: Hardware grants + Ev_Stock_Arrived have zero test coverage
detail: Grants are a new inventory feature (balance.grants delivers at ticks 600/1200/1800/2400). No test asserts Ev_Stock_Arrived fires, inventory rises, or the grant lands at the right tick — the 3100-tick surge run inspects events only for Surge.
recommended_fix: Add a test that steps across a grant at_tick and asserts Ev_Stock_Arrived fired once with the catalog deltas, and inventory.links/routers rose by exactly the grant amount (no double-apply).

title: Action-log binary round-trip skips Cmd_Place_Router (tag 7) + 4 other command kinds
evidence:
serialize.odin log_write (tag 7 has a non-trivial type_idx + 2D pos payload):
	case Cmd_Place_Router:
		w_u8(&w, 7); w_u16(&w, c.type_idx); w_i32(&w, c.pos[0]); w_i32(&w, c.pos[1])

determinism_test.odin round-trip (seeded only by wire_boot, compared only 2 kinds):
	testkit_wire_boot(state, 0)
	bytes := log_write(state, context.temp_allocator)
	...
		#partial switch ca in ka {
		case Cmd_Draw_Pipe:
		...
		case Cmd_Set_Pipe_Priority:

wire_boot appends only Cmd_Draw_Pipe + Cmd_Set_Pipe_Priority (testkit.odin:45,51,61).
detail: wire_boot emits only Draw_Pipe + Set_Pipe_Priority, so the round-trip covers tags 1,5. The new Cmd_Place_Router (tag 7: type_idx + 2D pos) and Upgrade/Demolish/Lane_Weights/Triage are never serialized then re-parsed; harness demos place routers.
recommended_fix: Extend the round-trip test to seed a log with every Command_Kind (draw, upgrade, demolish, lane-weights, place-router, triage) and assert each survives log_write->log_read field-for-field.

title: Draw_Pipe link-consume has no direct post-apply delta assertion
evidence:
Router placement consume IS asserted (topology_test.odin:268):
	if state.inventory.routers[basic] != 0 { tfail(t, "placement must consume the router") }

But every link-consume before-count is captured AFTER the draws (topology_test.odin:144, after 3 wide draws at :140-143):
	links_before := state.inventory.links[wide]
and :192-193 (std_before/wide_before after the :189 draw). No test asserts a standalone Draw_Pipe apply decremented inv.links[tier] by 1.
detail: Router placement consume IS asserted (routers[basic]==0 after apply). Draw_Pipe link consume is only implied via the upgrade exchange; before-counts are captured post-draw, so a wrong-tier decrement hides.
recommended_fix: After a standalone Draw_Pipe apply, assert inv.links[tier] fell by exactly 1 (mirror the router-consume check) so a wrong-index decrement can't hide behind the exchange test.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Aggregate of the gaps above: grants/Ev_Stock_Arrived (run.odin:165, 0 test references) and the Cmd_Place_Router log round-trip (serialize.odin:249-250, uncovered by determinism_test.odin:111-129) are the load-bearing P1 holes; P0 (determinism spine test_replay_byte_identical_on_real_topology, core loop, non-negative inventory) is fully pinned.
detail: P0 100% (determinism spine, core loop, non-negative inventory all pinned). P1 ~85%: inventory edits/rejections well-covered, but grants/Ev_Stock_Arrived and the Cmd_Place_Router log round-trip are uncovered; autopilot port-reserve is outcome-tested only. Overall ~85%.
recommended_fix: Add a grants-landing test (Ev_Stock_Arrived + inventory delta) and extend the log round-trip to every Command_Kind to lift P1 to >=90% (PASS).
